name: BF-ODD-SHAPE-ROBOT-01
brief: A non-rectangular robotics sensor hub with mounting ears, a cable notch, USB-C, CAN, I2C, UART/GPS, SWD, IMU, barometer, and 3V3/5V rails.

outline.shape: rounded odd shield with two mounting ears and connector notch

knownRisks: connector edge placement can block routes
mounting ears can create narrow corridors
notch can create copper-edge clearance pressure
